[[Archaeology/Legends|Archaeologists]] discovered evidence that in approximately [[1,000,000 BBY]] an [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]], [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] '''species''' inhabited [[Jerrilek]],<ref name="Loyalties" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located on the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]] of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> All that remained of the [[Species/Legends|species]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] were ruined [[City/Legends|cities]] in the depths of the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="Loyalties" /> Due to the ruins, rumors spread about the possibility of the species.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|158|Jerrilek}}</ref>

==Beind the scenes==
This species was created by [[James L. Cambias]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure "[[Loyalties]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 4|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 4]] in [[1994]]. The species fleshed out the planet profile but did not feature in the adventure. Cambias did suggest several ideas for further adventures on Jerrilek, which included suggestions that the species was not necessarily extinct, had been students of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] or that their ruins contained advanced technological devices.<ref name="Loyalties" /> The species was also mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].
